text:
maria: uploaded nsys capture from last night's stress run — major HBM spikes during long sequences. trace: https://redwood.internal/traces/2245007890
ajay: opened. rough glance: big memcpy kernels aligned with kv-read bursts.
maria: exact command i used:
```bash
nsys profile --trace=cuda,cublas,nvtx --sample=none -o /tmp/trace_2245 \\n  --capture-range=nvtx:encode,stop python -m run_infer --config=longseq.yaml
```
sasha: perfetto timeline? need thread view and GPU memcpy lanes.
maria: perfetto link: https://perfetto.redwood/trace/2245007890
devon: quick findings from nsys summary: peak HBM burst ~850GB/s for 120ms windows, average read latency up 30% at seqlen>=2048.
linh: kernel dispatch note: at seqlen 2048 we're selecting int8_matmul_v2 (kernel idx 47) which does extra staging to HBM mirror page.
ajay: that staging looks like the culprit — AVX-like fallback copies data to contiguous slab before kernel runs.
sasha: KV cache pattern: observed ripple eviction every ~64k reqs, coincides with HBM waves. evictions trigger DMA refetches for same keys.
devon: captured CUPTI metrics: dram_read_bytes, dram_write_bytes, l2_hit_rate. dram_read spikes match memcpy times.
maria: small snippet from nsys timeline (condensed):
```
[0.0s] kernel: kv_read_batch (GPU memcpy H2D) 88ms
[0.09s] kernel: int8_matmul_v2 30ms
[0.12s] kernel: kv_read_batch 76ms
...
```
ajay: batching heuristics note — continuous batching is grouping variable-length requests; when one long sequence enters microbatch it forces others into longer paths -> KV window grows.
linh: proposal: change kernel selection threshold for int8_matmul_v2 from 1792 -> 2304 and add fastpath for >1536 to use fp16_matmul_no_staging.
sasha: also propose KV prefetch coalescing: delay eviction-triggered prefetches by 5ms and aggregate keys per page to reduce DMA thrash.
perf-bot: perf-regression alert — 2026-03-15T08:21: CPU CI detected +22% p99 tail on longseq suite after commit abc1234.
maria: test patch branch: kj/avoid-staging-2048. pushed quick prototype: changes in kernel_selector.cpp and kv_prefetcher.cc
devon: can we add a perfetto annotation around kv-prefetch NVTX scope to correlate?
ajay: yes, add NVTX ranges: NVTX_PUSH("kv_prefetch_group"); NVTX_POP();
maria: next steps: (1) run gated nsys capture with CUPTI counters for dram_read/write and l2; (2) run perfetto with NVTX; (3) bench patch kj/avoid-staging-2048 on dedicated GPU pool; (4) roll canary if p99 improves.
sasha: assigning @linh to prototype coalescing, @ajay to kernel_selector tweak, @devon to perf traces.
maria: thanks — i'll coordinate canary. :thumbsup:
ajay: ack
linh: on it
devon: will schedule captures
